title: The Fortune Cultivator's Second Book
summary: A second book that carries the small pulls on a thread into the first real twists of luck for the student and against the foe.

title: Companion to the Cast Lots
summary: A companion on the casting of a lot for a foe and for a friend and on the guard that holds when the lot falls ill.

title: A Treatise on the Frayed Thread
summary: A treatise on unpicking the threads of intent in a foe's body until their grip and their plan both come apart.

title: The Reckoner's Handbook of Likelihoods
summary: A handbook of reckoning the likelier of two outcomes and of the blows and screens that lean a whole exchange the same way.
